name: sri-vidya-narayan-foundation
title: Sri Vidya Narayan Foundation — A Tribute to Swamiji
purpose: An interactive, photograph-led tribute to Sri Vidyanarayana Thirtha Swamiji through the foundation.
architecture: Framework-free static website with structured JSON content and a Python-only build

publication.target: GitHub Pages or another static host
publication.status: GitHub repository created; published through the included GitHub Pages workflow.

principles: A tribute to a living spiritual guide, with specific stories and restrained language
Visible choices and short captions before long reading
Stable categories, event folders and media provenance for future additions
Source originals remain unchanged; public derivatives are reviewed separately
No unsupported event dates, donation amounts, identities or outcomes

snapshot.description: Refreshed from the current website, event manifests, and foundation-supplied material. Later uploads can be added through the project workflow.

whatsapp_intake.mode: Owner-only guided conversation in one dedicated upload group
whatsapp_intake.requires: Linked WhatsApp device; awake and online Mac; existing GitHub CLI login
whatsapp_intake.status: Implemented and locally tested; account linking and live WhatsApp publication pending
